stem: A store in Karachi offers a \(10\%\) discount on the list price of a phone. An \(18\%\) sales tax is then added to the discounted price. A customer pays a total of 26,550 rupees for the phone. What is the list price of the phone, in rupees?
solution: Let \(L\) be the list price. After the discount the price is \(0.9L\); after the tax it is \(1.18 \cdot 0.9L = 1.062L\).
verify:
L = symbols('L')
sol = solve(Eq(L * Rational(9, 10) * Rational(118, 100), 26550), L)
assert sol == [25000]
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == sol[0] and len(spr_answers) == 1
